lines.text: One of the seven angels carries John in the Spirit into a wilderness, where he sees a woman on a scarlet beast.
The woman is dressed in blue and white and holds a golden cup, and Nineveh is written on her forehead.
The beast will come up out of the Abyss, and its seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
The ten kings will receive authority for seven years along with the beast, and they will make war against the Lamb.
The waters are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues, and the woman is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.
